scope.rule: every page after each section header, up to the next header, skipping divider pages (a blank or "---" name); the E-commerce section must end on Gift Cards
scope.onDisagreement: the build throws and names the pages; it never guesses
scope.shape: every page in scope must hold exactly one component set with Type × Breakpoint × Direction; helper sets (no Type, no Breakpoint) are recorded as parts; any other set stops the build unless it is listed in EXTRA_SETS
